description: Straßenbestandsverzeichnis der Stadt Hameln is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The road dedication defines the user types (e.g. community street) but also, if necessary, the user group (e.g. cyclists). Dedications must be publicly announced. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "List of streets of Hameln" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Stadt Hameln, Verkehrsnetze. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
